title: Medicare Open Enrollment & Health Insurance Changes with Leanne Malone - WGNS Radio
text:
Medicare Open Enrollment & Health Insurance Changes with Leanne Malone 
 Medicare Open Enrollment & Health Insurance Changes with Leanne Malone
 Nov 03, 2026 at 10:16 am 
 Master your healthcare and Medicare options before costly policy mistakes derail your coverage . Leanne Malone, founder of Cover My Assets Insurance Group, joins hosts Wayne Blair and Rick Hall to break down the shifting landscape of Medicare, Under-65 plans, and Marketplace health insurance . With major carriers exiting key markets and deductibles on the rise, staying passive during open enrollment can leave you with dropped providers, lost drug coverage, or massive out-of-pocket bills . 
 Discover the crucial difference between Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplements, how employer size dictates your transition timeline, and how new payment programs can smooth out steep prescription expenses . Leanne shares actionable steps to evaluate networks, avoid auto-enrollment pitfalls, and appeal high-income surcharges so your retirement health plan works directly for your wallet . 
 Key Takeaways: 
 Don't Ignore Plan Termination Notices: A dropped plan letter triggers a rare guarantee-issue window to switch plan types without medical underwriting . 
 Manage Soaring Drug Deductibles: Understand how the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan (MP3) spreads high-cost prescription caps across a 12-month zero-interest payment schedule . 
 The High-Income Assessment Rule: How two-year lookback tax assessments affect your Part B and Part D premiums—and the steps required to appeal after retiring . 
 Marketplace Fraud Guardrails: What new identity authorization rules and carrier changes mean for Under-65 enrollees during annual enrollment . 
 Crucial Deadlines: Why December 7 (Medicare) and December 15 (Marketplace) are make-or-break dates to guarantee seamless healthcare coverage on January 1 .
